_help.students: Who you want to raise, by the name shown in game, like "Hina": 5. Weight 0 ignores a student. Variants are separate students: "Hoshino" doesn't cover "Hoshino (Swimsuit)". A student the plan shows by a code like CH0176 must be listed by that code.
_help.default_weight: Value of an owned student who isn't listed.
_help.locations: allow: only these locations (empty means all). block: never these.
_help.fill_leftover_tickets: After every room with a student worth raising, spend remaining tickets on other rooms for their rewards.
